about.title: A kitchen built around generous tables
about.text1: Kilo started with one belief: the best meals are the ones shared. We pair slow-cooked classics with the speed and brightness of a market-fresh kitchen.
about.text2: We buy from growers and bakers we trust, cook over open flame and season by hand. Nothing is rushed, nothing is wasted, and everyone is welcome.
bullets: Fresh pita and flatbreads baked in-house

catering.title: Feeding a crowd?
catering.text: Sharing platters, mezze spreads and full banquets for office lunches, weddings and celebrations.

seo.title: Kilo Kitchen | Modern Mediterranean Restaurant
seo.description: Shakshuka, hand-whipped hummus, crisp falafel and slow-cooked classics. Reserve a table or order online.

menu.name: Classic Hummus

reviews.name: Sample Guest 1
reviews.text: Really great quality food, awesome flavors and dishes we would never know how to make at home. The shakshuka is unreal.

reviews.name: Sample Guest 2
reviews.text: The hummus alone is worth the trip. Warm service, generous portions and a room that feels like a celebration.

reviews.name: Sample Guest 3
reviews.text: We catered our office launch and every platter came back empty. Professional, on time and delicious.

faq.q: Do you cater for allergies and dietary needs?
faq.a: Every dish is labelled vegetarian, vegan or gluten-free where applicable. Tell us about allergies when you order or book and the kitchen will take care of you.
It depends on distance and how busy we are. You will see an estimated time at checkout, and you can track your order from this page.

faq.q: Can I book a private event?
faq.a: Yes, we host private dining and catering. Send us a message and we will reply as soon as we can.
